CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISNULL(Date_Paperwork_Received__c) , ISNULL( Service_Completion_Date__c )), 0, (Service_Completion_Date__c - Date_Paperwork_Received__c) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The number of days between Service Completion Date and Date Paperwork received. This field will display 0 if either date is not populated.
CustomField.label: Days Btwn Date Ppwk Recd and Srv Comp
